versions.changelog:
Initial release — generates evidence-bounded, competitive technology insight reports from pre-tagged patent datasets.

- Produces management-grade Markdown or self-contained HTML reports focused on technology trends, competitor positioning, taxonomies, and R&D/IP opportunities.
- Strict evidence boundary: analyzes only dimensions formally present in the provided dataset and documents data completeness, field readiness, and inference limits.
- Enforces workflow integrity: will not analyze unscreened, untagged, or partially tagged datasets without reporting coverage gaps.
- Requires explicit contract for input data structure, artifact provenance, and all counting/missing-value rules.
- Provides detailed methods and next-step data recommendations when critical analytical fields are missing.
